cypher_first_attempt: MATCH (d:Disease {commonName: "Alzheimer's Disease"})-[:DISEASELOCALIZESTOANATOMY]->(b:BodyPart) WITH COLLECT(b.commonName) AS alzheimersLocalizations MATCH (d2:Disease {commonName: "Familial Alzheimer Disease (FAD)"})-[:DISEASELOCALIZESTOANATOMY]->(b2:BodyPart) WITH alzheimersLocalizations, COLLECT(b2.commonName) AS fadLocalizations RETURN [x IN ["cerebellum", "cerebellar cortex", "central nervous system", "skin epidermis", "brain"] WHERE NOT x IN alzheimersLocalizations AND NOT x IN fadLocalizations] AS notLocalizations
cypher_final: MATCH (d:Disease) WHERE d.commonName IN ['Alzheimer\'s Disease', 'Familial Alzheimer Disease (FAD)'] MATCH (d)-[rel0:DISEASELOCALIZESTOANATOMY]->(b:BodyPart) RETURN d, b, rel0
